1wsb5h3:303: Existing coding agent benchmarks (such as SWE-bench) mainly focus on single-issue Python repository bug fixes and use coarse-grained pass/fail as evaluation results, failing to capture long-term, multi-objective development capability at real engineering scale. RoadmapBench fills this gap: each task places the agent on a source-version code snapshot, provides multi-objective roadmap instructions, and requires implementing features introduced in the target version, with a median modification of 3,700 lines across 51 files. Systematic evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art models shows that even the strongest model, Claude-Opus-4.7, solves only 39.1% of tasks, while the weakest solves only 5.2%, indicating that long-term software development remains a largely unsolved problem.
